content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for OAV Sandhapur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.khordha.odisha.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the OAV Sandhapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Sandhapur recruitment is 21 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 6 vacancies are available for the posts of Head Cook, Assistant Cook, and Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper in the Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Sandhapur recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for these posts is HSC (Higher Secondary Certificate). Specific details for each post are available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper post is between 21 to 32 years. Please refer to the official notification for details on age relaxation for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for OAV Sandhapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the OAV Sandhapur recruitment includes Document Verification, an Interview, and a Practical Cooking Test for relevant posts.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Head Cook position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Head Cook position is Rs. 9000/- per month. Other posts have different salary structures as detailed in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the job type for these positions in the Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Sandhapur recruitment is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. How can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Sandhapur, which is www.khordha.odisha.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. Where should I send the filled application form?
faq.answer: The completed application form along with necessary documents should be sent to the address mentioned in the official notification through Speed Post or Registered Post.
